audit_items.title: Can corrupted data columns from a compromised EL propagate to gossip subscribers and affect network-wide data availability?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: The check examines whether data columns received via P2P gossip are validated via KZG proofs before forwarding or storing. The spec requires verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs() to be called.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: validateDataColumnSidecar() in gossip_validation.nim:586-706 performs comprehensive validation including: (1) verify_data_column_sidecar() at line 596, (2) subnet validation at line 602, (3) inclusion proof at line 630, (4) proposer signature at line 689-696, and (5) KZG proofs at line 701-703.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The implementation validates KZG proofs via check_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs() which calls verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs() in peerdas_helpers.nim. All validation occurs BEFORE the sidecar is stored or forwarded.

attack_vectors: Compromised EL sending invalid blob data that passes initial validation but fails KZG proofs
Timing attacks where invalid data columns are briefly stored before KZG validation completes
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: The P2P gossip boundary is protected by the validateDataColumnSidecar function which rejects invalid data with ValidationResult.Reject, preventing propagation.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: VERIFIED: KZG validation occurs at line 701-703 BEFORE any storage or forwarding. The function returns errReject on failure, preventing propagation of corrupted data.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: ∀ data_column ∈ gossip_received: KZG_valid(data_column) ∨ reject(data_column)
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: None identified - validation is comprehensive and occurs before any state changes

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-008: Does distributed blob publishing enforce subnet subscription checks before publishing data columns?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: The check verifies that before publishing data columns to gossip, the code checks if the target subnet is in the node's current subscription list.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: In message_router.nim:162-163, data columns are published with compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(dataColumns[i].index) to determine the subnet. The actual publishing uses broadcastDataColumnSidecar.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The code computes the subnet for each data column but does NOT verify subscription status before publishing. This is by design - a block producer publishes to all subnets for their data columns regardless of their custody subscriptions.

attack_vectors: Publishing to non-subscribed subnets could fail silently
Subscription state changes during publish could cause partial publication
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: This is an internal-only boundary. The publishing node is the block producer and is expected to publish data columns to the appropriate subnets. The network layer handles subscription management.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: PARTIAL: Subnet computation is correct per spec but subscription verification is delegated to the network layer (eth2_network.nim).

phase3_assessment.formal_property: ∀ publish(data_column, subnet): subnet = compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(data_column.index)
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Network layer must handle subscription state correctly. This is outside the scope of message_router.

audit_items.title: Does the beacon node correctly maintain and enforce the subscription state for custody and sampling subnets during blob publishing?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: Verify that subscription state is consistent across all components that perform publishing.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: In routeSignedBeaconBlock (message_router.nim:170-180), the code retrieves custody_columns from resolve_columns_from_custody_groups() and only pushes those columns to the processor for which the node has custody.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The code correctly filters data columns based on custody group membership at lines 180-190. Only columns in custody_columns are added to final_columns.

attack_vectors: Race condition if custody groups change during block production
Inconsistency between network metadata and custody calculation
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: Internal state consistency is maintained by reading custody_group_count from network.metadata and using it consistently.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: VERIFIED: Custody columns are computed once and used consistently for filtering.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: final_columns ⊆ custody_columns(node_id)
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: If custody groups change mid-operation, there could be brief inconsistency, but this is benign.

phase1_findings.code_mapping: The broadcasting is done via broadcastDataColumnSidecar which uses the libp2p pubsub layer. Subscription management is handled separately in eth2_network.nim.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The gossip layer (libp2p) manages subscriptions. The beacon node calls broadcastDataColumnSidecar regardless of subscription state - libp2p handles delivery based on mesh topology.

attack_vectors: Publishing to topics where node is not subscribed may result in dropped messages
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: This is a gossip layer concern. The pubsub protocol handles message routing based on mesh membership.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: NOT DIRECTLY VERIFIABLE at application layer - relies on libp2p guarantees.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: Messages published to topics where node is not subscribed are handled by gossipsub protocol
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Relies on correct libp2p gossipsub implementation

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the anti-equivocation cache unconditionally updated when data columns are imported via P2P?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: The anti-equivocation check verifies that the sidecar is the first for (slot, proposer_index, column_index). This is done via dataColumnQuarantine.hasSidecar().
phase1_findings.code_mapping: In validateDataColumnSidecar:619-625, the code checks if dataColumnQuarantine already has a sidecar for the (block_root, slot, proposer_index, index) tuple. The sidecar is added to quarantine AFTER validation completes.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The cache (quarantine) is checked before acceptance, and sidecars are added to quarantine after passing validation. The cache update is not shown in validateDataColumnSidecar - it happens in the processor after validation passes.

attack_vectors: Time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) between validation and quarantine update
Concurrent imports could bypass the equivocation check
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: The P2P boundary check happens in validateDataColumnSidecar. The quarantine update happens in the block processor after successful validation.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: PARTIAL: The check is performed but the cache update flow needs to be traced through eth2_processor to confirm unconditional update.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: ∀ valid_import(data_column): hasSidecar(root, slot, proposer, index) → IGNORE
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Need to verify cache update in processor. Possible race window between check and update.

audit_items.title: Can an equivocating proposer bypass anti-equivocation detection by exploiting conditional cache update logic in distributed blob publishing?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: Test whether conditional logic in publication path could skip cache updates, allowing equivocation.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: The check in validateDataColumnSidecar:619-625 uses block_root (derived from hash_tree_root of block_header) as part of the cache key. This means different block roots for same (slot, proposer) would not be detected as equivocation at the gossip layer.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: POTENTIAL ISSUE: The cache key includes block_root, not just (slot, proposer_index, column_index). Two different blocks from the same proposer at the same slot would have different block_roots and thus different cache keys, bypassing the duplicate check.

attack_vectors: Proposer creates two different blocks for same slot, each with different block_root
Both sets of data columns could pass validation as they have different block_roots
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: The anti-equivocation at gossip layer only prevents duplicate data columns for the SAME block, not equivocating blocks from the same proposer.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: VULNERABLE: The check protects against duplicate columns for same block but not against equivocating blocks. However, equivocating BLOCKS are handled separately by block validation which checks for proposer slashing.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: The data column equivocation check is scoped to (block_root, slot, proposer, index), not (slot, proposer, index)
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Block-level equivocation is detected via proposer slashing checks in block validation, not data column validation

audit_items.title: Does the beacon node correctly update anti-equivocation state for all data column import scenarios including local block production?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: Enumerate all code paths where data columns can be imported and verify anti-equivocation cache is updated.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: For local block production, routeSignedBeaconBlock broadcasts data columns at lines 165-178 then adds block to processor at line 190. The processor handles quarantine updates.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: Local block production goes through blockProcessor.addBlock which should update the quarantine/cache. The path is: routeSignedBeaconBlock → broadcastDataColumnSidecar → blockProcessor.addBlock

attack_vectors: If broadcast fails but block is added, cache may not be updated for gossiped columns
Local vs gossip import paths may have different cache update behavior
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: Local blocks bypass gossip validation but still go through block processor. The cache update happens in block processor, ensuring consistency.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: PARTIAL: Need to trace blockProcessor.addBlock to confirm cache update for local blocks.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: All import paths (gossip, local) must update anti-equivocation cache
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Need to verify blockProcessor handles local blocks correctly

audit_items.title: Is there a post-condition violation where anti-equivocation cache state diverges from actual imported data column state?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: Verify that after any successful data column import, the anti-equivocation cache contains an entry for (proposer, slot, column_index).
phase1_findings.code_mapping: The quarantine's hasSidecar and put functions manage the cache. The cache is checked in gossip_validation.nim and updated when sidecars are added to quarantine.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: The quarantine (ColumnQuarantine) tracks sidecars by (block_root, column_index). The hasSidecar check in validation uses (root, slot, proposer_index, index).

attack_vectors: State divergence if quarantine pruning removes entries before block is finalized
Concurrent access to quarantine could cause inconsistency
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: The quarantine is a short-term storage. Once blocks are added to DAG, the quarantine entries are no longer needed for equivocation detection.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: BY-DESIGN: Quarantine is temporary storage; long-term equivocation detection happens via proposer slashing in consensus.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: Quarantine provides short-term equivocation detection; consensus provides long-term detection via slashing
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Brief window where pruned quarantine entries could allow re-import of same sidecar, but this is benign as block would be duplicate.

audit_items.title: Is the atomicity of blob publishing guaranteed such that partial publication cannot occur during EL communication failures?

phase1_findings.specification_analysis: Review for atomicity guarantees during data column publication.
phase1_findings.code_mapping: In routeSignedBeaconBlock:145-180, the block is broadcast first, then data columns are broadcast concurrently via das_workers. Block addition to processor happens after broadcasts complete.
phase1_findings.gap_assessment: PARTIAL ATOMICITY: Block broadcast happens before data column broadcasts. If block broadcast succeeds but data column broadcasts fail, the block is still added to the chain but data availability is incomplete.

attack_vectors: Network failure during data column broadcast after block broadcast
Partial data column publication leaving block without full DA
phase2_findings.boundary_analysis: The publication is NOT atomic. Block and data columns are broadcast separately. However, failure in data column broadcast does not prevent block addition.
phase2_findings.invariant_verification: BY-DESIGN: The spec allows partial publication. Data availability sampling handles missing columns via re-request.

phase3_assessment.formal_property: Block publication is independent of data column publication success
phase3_assessment.residual_risks: Partial publication is spec-compliant; network handles missing columns via request/response protocols

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Can the slotted_freezable mechanism for Header objects be bypassed?
audit_items.reason: This check relates to Execution Layer (EL) Header objects and slotted_freezable mechanism. This is a Consensus Layer (Nimbus beacon chain) codebase which does not implement EL Header handling.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are all 21 header fields validated before block acceptance?
audit_items.reason: This check relates to Execution Layer (EL) block header validation (21 EL header fields). This is a Consensus Layer codebase - EL header validation is performed by the Execution Layer client.

audit_items.reason: This check relates to EL blob gas accounting (blob_gas_used, excess_blob_gas). While CL handles blob sidecars, the gas accounting validation is EL responsibility.
